# Specification patterns

- Prefer one spec per independently discussable or deliverable feature.
- Do not create one spec per source file or function.
- Keep test and implementation plans in the feature spec unless they become independently owned or complex.
- Use acceptance criteria that can be reviewed or verified.
- Use ADRs for significant architectural decisions and specs for intended feature behavior.
- Keep specs short, outcome-focused, and consistent with the C99 and Make workflow.
